name: Mobile Nail Technician
tagline: Mobile manicures, pedicures, gel, acrylic, parties
service_types: Nursing Home and Aged Care Visits
extra_prompt: You are booking for a mobile nail technician. Ask about the service, nail condition, location, and whether they want a group booking. Ask about allergies and skin conditions. Ask about access to power and a table. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on the day. Do not promise a specific result without seeing the nails.

kb.q: How much does a mobile manicure cost?
kb.a: {price_note} A travel fee applies beyond 15 km from our base. We confirm the total before booking.
Yes, we come to your home, office, or venue. Travel fees apply beyond 15 km, and we confirm them when you book.

kb.q: Do you do gel and acrylic?
kb.a: Yes, we do gel, acrylic, and SNS nails. Tell us the length and style you want so we can book enough time.
Yes, we do custom nail art, which is charged per nail. Send us a photo of the design you like before the visit.
Yes, we do infills and rebalances for gel and acrylic. Book your infill on time to keep the set in good condition.
Yes, we remove gel and acrylic. Removal is charged separately, and we confirm the cost when you book.
Yes, we do mobile pedicures and luxury pedicures. Tell us your preferred treatment when you book.
Yes, we do bridal nails and on-site bridal parties. Book a trial before the big day if you want to test the look.
Yes, we offer kids' nails. Let us know the child's age when you book so we can plan the session.
Yes, we visit nursing homes and retirement villages. Please check access rules with the facility before we arrive.
Yes, we do pamper parties and group bookings. Groups have a minimum of 4 people, and the per-person rate is in our price list.

kb.q: What do you need on site?
kb.a: A table, two chairs, and access to a power point. Tell us if the group is larger, and we will confirm the setup.

kb.q: Do you have a minimum booking?
kb.a: {minimum_note} Tell us your booking size and we will confirm whether it meets the minimum.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Please let us know as early as you can if your plans change.
We hold [your insurance type] cover through [your insurer]. A certificate is available on request.
We service [your service area] and the surrounding suburbs. Ask us to confirm your suburb before you book.

compliance.guidance: Tattooing and skin penetration services are regulated by state health departments and usually need registration. Hair and beauty work needs infection control. Massage practitioners may need registration with a recognised body. Check your state rules.
